scope: Replaces the process-local Streamlit session registry with a durable Supabase session table
Stores only a SHA-256 hash of the opaque browser marker and keeps access/refresh tokens server-side
Uses a server-only SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to restore sessions across browser refreshes and Render process changes
Reads the browser marker through Streamlit context with a controlled CookieManager fallback before protected-page guards redirect
Refreshes expiring Supabase tokens, revalidates HealthyMe roles, revokes sessions on logout and expires legacy markers
excluded: No Flutter or Admin Lite code change
No assessment, report, recommendation, schedule or member-data contract change
No password, access token or refresh token stored in browser cookies, URLs or local storage
H13A and H13B process-local session records are intentionally not migrated; users sign in once after H13C deployment
